#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int needed = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < needed) size <<= 1;

    vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(ar, ai, false);

    vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        br[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        bi[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(br, bi, false);

    vector<double> cr1(size, 0.0), ci1(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> cr2(size, 0.0), ci2(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;
        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;

        cr1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        ci1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        cr2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        ci2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(cr1, ci1, true);
    fft(cr2, ci2, true);

    vector<int> out(needed);
    for (int i = 0; i < needed; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(cr1[i]);
        long long bb = llround(cr2[i]);
        long long cc = llround(ci1[i]);
        out[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return out;
}

void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
    int n = re.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            double t = re[i]; re[i] = re[j]; re[j] = t;
            t = im[i]; im[i] = im[j]; im[j] = t;
        }
    }

    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        double ang = 2 * M_PI / len * (inv ? -1 : 1);
        double wRe = cos(ang), wIm = sin(ang);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double wr = 1.0, wi = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                double ur = re[i + j], ui = im[i + j];
                double vr = re[i + j + len / 2] * wr - im[i + j + len / 2] * wi;
                double vi = re[i + j + len / 2] * wi + im[i + j + len / 2] * wr;
                re[i + j] = ur + vr;
                im[i + j] = ui + vi;
                re[i + j + len / 2] = ur - vr;
                im[i + j + len / 2] = ui - vi;
                double tmp = wr * wRe - wi * wIm;
                wi = wr * wIm + wi * wRe;
                wr = tmp;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inv) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& in;
    char buf[1024];
    int ptr, len;

public:
    InputReader(istream& input) : in(input), ptr(0), len(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (ptr >= len) {
            ptr = 0;
            in.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            len = in.gcount();
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[ptr++] & 0xFF;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (c <= 32) c = read();
        int s = 1;
        if (c == '-') { s = -1; c = read(); }
        int x = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid input");
            x = x * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (c > 32);
        return x * s;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        v[in.nextInt()] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> res = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            res = multiply(res, v, MOD);
        }
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp == 0) break;
        v = multiply(v, v, MOD);
    }
    long long total = 0;
    for (int val : res) {
        total = (total + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << total << endl;
    return 0;
}
